candidates.excerpt: The Anti-Corruption Bureau caught GHMC Town Planning Supervisor Tulasiram Sunitha accepting Rs 4 lakh as the first instalment of an alleged Rs 8 lakh bribe in Mehdipatnam. The ACB also seized Rs 2.5 lakh in unaccounted cash from her possession.

candidates.title: Water Supply Briefly Hit In Parts Of Secretariat
candidates.excerpt: Drinking water supply was briefly disrupted in parts of Telangana Secretariat after contractors halted can deliveries over pending bills.te

candidates.title: Pakistan-made cosmetics worth Rs 7 lakh seized in Hyderabad, wider network suspected
candidates.excerpt: Pakistan-made cosmetics, including skin-whitening creams and soaps, are allegedly being sold in Hyderabad despite lacking mandatory approvals. Task Force officials and CDSCO recently seized products worth around Rs 7 lakh, while police are investigating a wider distribution network.

candidates.title: Hyderabad Ganesh event death: Organiser booked over alleged safety violations
candidates.excerpt: Musheerabad police arrested a 34-year-old real estate businessman in connection with the death of a 19-year-old youth during a Ganesh Agaman event on September 5. Police alleged negligence, unauthorised arrangements and excessive sound levels contributed to panic during the procession

candidates.title: Jagtial man stuck in Dubai jail over Rs 39 lakh court penalty despite completing his prison term
candidates.excerpt: The court has sentenced him for illegally entering the United Arab Emirates (UAE) from Oman without a passport or visa and his alleged illegal stay in Dubai for nearly eight years.

candidates.title: Dasoju Sravan seeks action plan to address Telangana education crisis
candidates.excerpt: BRS MLC Dasoju Sravan urged the Telangana government to address teacher vacancies, school closures and higher education staffing gaps. He sought an annual DSC calendar, regular recruitment, pending DAs and promotions, while demanding at least 15 per cent of the State budget for education

candidates.title: Centre clears elevation of three High Court Chief Justices as SC judges
candidates.excerpt: Acting on the recommendation of the Supreme Court Collegium, the Centre has cleared the elevation of Gujarat High Court Chief Justice Sunita Agarwal, Delhi High Court Chief Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya, and Telangana High Court Chief Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh as judges of the apex court.
